pendingTrademarks.name: Trade mark registration for the "VARDHMAN PRECISION" device mark in Class 12

draft: Our Company has a pending trade mark registration for the "VARDHMAN PRECISION" device mark in Class 12. Our application for this trademark is currently pending. Until registration is granted by the relevant authorities, we may be unable to prevent third parties from using an identical or deceptively similar mark. Any such unauthorized use by third parties could adversely affect our business, reputation, and operations, and we cannot assure you that our trademark application will be approved or registered in a timely manner, or at all.
